parameters.content:
## 01 ClickUp lead stage → Supabase
ClickUp stays the advisors' working CRM; Supabase keeps the **first time** each funnel stage was reached (timestamps never move backwards, so funnel and journey-days stay auditable).

Upsert key: `clickup_task_id`. When a lead moves to **Discovery set**, Smallest.ai schedules AI reminder calls at **T-24h** and **T-1h** to lift show-up (idempotency key = task + call time + slot).

Edit `STAGE_BY_STATUS` if the Leads list statuses are renamed.

parameters.query:
with camp as (        -- stub so the FK holds if the lead lands before the daily Meta pull
  insert into campaigns (id, name, objective)
  select $4::text, $4::text, 'program' where $4::text is not null
  on conflict (id) do nothing
), ad as (
  insert into ad_creatives (id, campaign_id, name)
  select $5::text, $4::text, $5::text where $5::text is not null and $4::text is not null
  on conflict (id) do nothing
)
insert into leads as l (clickup_task_id, created_at, source, campaign_id, ad_id, parent_name, parent_phone,
                        teen_grade, discovery_call_at, drop_reason, qualified_at, discovery_set_at,
                        discovery_showed_at, ambition_interview_at, architect_session_at, outcome, closed_at)
values ($1, $2::timestamptz, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8::smallint, $9::timestamptz, $10,
        case when $11 = 'qualified'          then $12::timestamptz end,
        case when $11 = 'discovery_set'      then $12::timestamptz end,
        case when $11 = 'discovery_showed'   then $12::timestamptz end,
        case when $11 = 'ambition_interview' then $12::timestamptz end,
        case when $11 = 'architect_session'  then $12::timestamptz end,
        case when $11 in ('trial','full','dropped') then $11 else 'open' end,
        case when $11 in ('trial','full','dropped') then $12::timestamptz end)
on conflict (clickup_task_id) do update set
  source                = excluded.source,
  campaign_id           = coalesce(excluded.campaign_id, l.campaign_id),
  ad_id                 = coalesce(excluded.ad_id, l.ad_id),
  parent_name           = coalesce(excluded.parent_name, l.parent_name),
  parent_phone          = coalesce(excluded.parent_phone, l.parent_phone),
  teen_grade            = coalesce(excluded.teen_grade, l.teen_grade),
  discovery_call_at     = coalesce(excluded.discovery_call_at, l.discovery_call_at),
  drop_reason           = coalesce(excluded.drop_reason, l.drop_reason),
  qualified_at          = coalesce(l.qualified_at, excluded.qualified_at),
  discovery_set_at      = coalesce(l.discovery_set_at, excluded.discovery_set_at),
  discovery_showed_at   = coalesce(l.discovery_showed_at, excluded.discovery_showed_at),
  ambition_interview_at = coalesce(l.ambition_interview_at, excluded.ambition_interview_at),
  architect_session_at  = coalesce(l.architect_session_at, excluded.architect_session_at),
  outcome               = case when excluded.outcome <> 'open' then excluded.outcome else l.outcome end,
  closed_at             = case when excluded.outcome <> 'open' then coalesce(l.closed_at, excluded.closed_at) else l.closed_at end,
  updated_at            = now()
returning l.id as lead_id, l.clickup_task_id, l.parent_name, l.parent_phone, l.discovery_call_at, $11 as stage

insert into ingest_log (workflow, rows, status, execution_id)
values ($1, $2, $3, $4)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ agent_id: $env.SMALLEST_REMINDER_AGENT_ID, phone_number: $json.phone, scheduled_at: $json.scheduled_at, idempotency_key: $json.idempotency_key, variables: { parent_name: $json.parent_name, call_time: DateTime.fromISO($json.call_at).setZone('Asia/Kolkata').toFormat('ccc d LLL, h:mm a'), reminder: $json.slot } }) }}
